rca of the issue: Share card RV-TB label clipping: share_card.py uses a fixed font size for the big RV-TB-XXXXXX heading (~150-180pt Syne-ExtraBold) without measuring against a safe max-width. A 12-char string 'RV-TB-XXXXXX' at that size exceeds ~1080-2*margin px, so Pillow draws it and the last glyph gets cropped by the canvas boundary. Fix: use font.getbbox() on the target string, compute scale = safe_width / measured_width, and clamp font size = int(base_size * min(1.0, scale)) before rendering. Alternatively wrap the label onto a second line if width > safe_width.
